metadata.title: 対角線に沿う正方形の被覆を、重なり補正と枚数の罰金で最小にする
metadata.summary: 包含される要求を除き、撮影範囲を連続した群へ分ける。重複面積を引くDPの離散凸性を示し、整数の罰金と単調な直線群で枚数の次元を除く。
aliases: 対角正方形の和集合被覆
overlap corrected photo partition WQS CHT
Monge枚数離散凸と整数罰金
metadata.family: 重なりを持つ区間被覆と枚数制約の最適化

reference.title: 宇宙人 (Aliens)
reference.evidence: 全指定セルを、主対角線上に向かい合う角を持つ正方形の高々K枚で覆い、重複セルを一度だけ数えた面積を最小にする。要求を[min(r,c),max(r,c)]へ移して包含を除去し、連続群の面積から直前写真の重複二乗を引く。Mongeの入れ子辺交換から枚数別費用の離散凸性を示し、少数枚tieを整数encodeした罰金DPを単調CHTで計算する。原典N10万/M100万/K全域をO(NlogN+NlogM)時間・O(N)空間で扱う。
reference.verificationNotes: 最終ISC原典3頁/公式Solutions集17頁中Aliens14〜17頁/Day2Notice/JP日程を確認。公式の区間化・重複補正・CHT・罰金方針へ、写真の連続群化/全unionと隣接重複の同値・Mongeからq−1/q+1経路のq/q均衡交換・整数境界と少数枚tie・128bit比較上界を独立補足する。全小literal square-cell union→別pairwise containment/partition DP→実fence hull cost/countと最終API、最大30構成・不正・反復・14 allocation faultsを検証。実headerzip未取得を明示し、原典genericとNotice型対応からadapterを導出する。凍結初回研究6/coverage0/API0は不変で、独立reviewと実接続後のresolutionだけを追加する。

problemFeatureProposal.title: 宇宙人 (Aliens)
features: 対角線上に角を持つマス目の正方形で全指定セルを覆う
高々K枚、重複セルは一度だけ数える面積の最小化
指定セル1〜10万/盤面一辺1〜100万/座標0始まり、点重複可

flowProposal.parentChoiceLabel: 主対角線上に角を持つ正方形を高々K個選び、全点を覆う面積を最小にする

guards.question: マス目に沿った正方形を選び、向かい合う二つの角が同じ主対角線上にありますか？
guards.explanation: 指定セルを全て覆います。二つの角を主対角線上に持つので、各範囲は同じ区間[a,b]を行と列へ使う[a,b]²です。

guards.question: 高々K個で全指定セルを覆い、重なったマスは一度だけ数えて面積を最小にしますか？
guards.explanation: 指定セルの重複は許されます。K枚を必ず異なる範囲で使う制約ではなく、写真の単純な面積和も目的としません。

guards.question: 指定セルは1〜10万個、盤面の一辺は1〜100万で、Kは1〜指定セル数ですか？
guards.explanation: 座標は盤面内の0始まり整数です。面積は64bit、直線の交点比較は128bitで計算します。

api.originalAdapterSignature: long long take_photos(int n,int m,int k,std::vector<int> r,std::vector<int> c)
api.input: N1..100000, grid_size1..1000000, K1..N, each0<=r,c<grid_size. Duplicates and symmetric cells allowed.
api.output: Minimum union cell count; no photo list. At mostK, count clamped only AFTER duplicate/containment removal.
api.empty: invalid_argument for zero points, original requiresN>=1.
api.errors: invalid_argument for core N/M/K/range bounds and adapter explicitN or vector-size mismatch. All public validation scans precede internal scratch allocation; adapter by-value argument copies may allocate before function entry. bad_alloc and other standard allocation exceptions propagate.
api.internalHelper: diagonal_square_union_detail::penalized is not public API; assumes nonempty containment-free strict endpoints and workspace large enough. Workspace head/tail reset at every penalty call.
api.time: O(NlogN+NlogM), all validation O(N); by-value adapter additional O(N) copies and pair conversion.
api.auxiliarySpace: O(N), interval vector up to8N bytes plus hull16B bytes on32bit int/64bit int64; one reserve and one hull allocation reused across penalties, standard sort stack O(logN).

integerSafety.storedFields: int64 intercept/slope/encodedDP/penalty/result; cast before integer difference or product for crossing comparison/evaluation.
integerSafety.coordinateSafety: Validate sizes before int casts; right+1<=M; L−1 promoted to int64, may equal−1.

proof.intervalEquivalence: Square[a,b]² contains cell(r,c) iff it contains[min(r,c),max(r,c)]. Remove contained requirements by leftasc/rightdesc and increasingright scan; duplicate/equalleft intervals drop correctly, both remaining endpoints strictlyincrease.
proof.consecutiveAssignment: Remove contained photos, sort both endpoints. Assign each requirement to first covering photo; earlier/later reversal contradicts ordered endpoints, so assigned indices are consecutive. Shrink each photo to group firstL/lastR without increasing union.
proof.unionCorrection: Intersection of new photo with all earlier union equals its intersection with previous photo, since earlier right endpoints<=previousright and newleft>=all earlierleft. Inclusive overlap side=max(0,R_t−L_{t+1}+1); subtract its square exactly once.
proof.monge: For a<=b<c<=d: W(a,c)+W(b,d)−W(a,d)−W(b,c)=−2(L_{b+1}−L_{a+1})(R_d−R_c)<=0. Source-dependent overlap row constants cancel.
proof.discreteConvexity: Optimal(q−1)- and(q+1)-edge paths; first prefix where Q internalcuts exceed P by2 gives nested edgesa→c,b→d witha<=b<d<=c and prefix-edge count difference1. Swap suffixes via crossinga→d,b→c; both getq edges and Monge makes combinedcost no larger. Common cut uses suffix swap with unchangedcost. Thus2Fq<=Fq−1+Fq+1.
proof.atMostReduction: Splitting a group into2 smaller photos inside original cannot increase union. F nonincreasing, so atmostK equals exact min(K,B) nonemptygroups.
proof.integerPenalty: SavingsDelta_q=F(q−1)−F(q) nonincreasing nonnegative integers. Among min(F(q)+lambda*q), choose smallerq. First integerlambda with chosenq<=K supportsK too, even a countjump; thereforeG−lambda*K=F(K). Iflambda0 already hascount<=K, G0=F(K). lambdaM² uniquely chooses1 because all nonemptyphoto unions positive andF1<=M².
proof.encodedTies: H=B+1; DPvalue=H*(penalizedcost)+count with1<=count<=B. Primary/secondary ordering exact, noEPS. Perphoto addsH*lambda+1; divide/modH restorescost/count.
proof.monotoneHull: After filtering L/R strictincrease, slopes−2H(L−1) strictdecrease and queryR increases. Three-line intersection test removes useless middle; front comparison removes lines that cannot win at laterx. Each line added/popped once perpenalty. Scratch preallocated once.

validation.literalOracle: ALL possible integer diagonal-square subsets onM1..5; union of actual M² cell bitmaps and required-cell coverage. Superset-min across requiredsets and atmostphoto count. No production containment scan/overlap/Monge/penalty/hull used.

validation.independentContainment: Pairwise O(N²) dominance over every input interval; strict or earlier-index tie removal. Does not reuse sorting scan.
validation.partitionOracle: All exactq cubic DP after independent pairwise filter; crossed with literal squares. Verifies nonincrease/convexity, real internal hullcost AND count for all smalllambda0..M² plus randompenalties.
validation.literalPartitionUnion: For444 random/structured cases, enumerate every cutmask (65176 assignments) and use generic square-union sweep over coordinatebands. No neighbor-overlap subtraction; cross-check every exactq DP value.
